{{Quote|The Alliance is bleeding systems... the ones who sit out the war or who actively join the Empire! We need a decisive move to achieve victory while we still can!|Piers Petan|<ref name="Legacy 20" />}}
'''Piers Petan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Rear Admiral/Legends|Rear Admiral]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|Defense Fleet]] during the [[Sith–Imperial War]]. Petan was tricked by Imperials in the Battle of Caamas and defeated, causing the fall of the Galactic Alliance.

==Biography==
Piers Petan was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] with the rank of [[Rear Admiral/Legends|Rear Admiral]] in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. In [[130 ABY]], Petan proposed a plan to the [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Triumvirate]] of performing an attack with the goal of killing or capturing [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]], who was rumored to meet with representatives of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Ascendancy]] and the [[Hapan|Hapes]] [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Consortium]].<ref name="Legacy 20" />

Even though the plan was rejected by Triumvir [[Gial Gahan]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]], and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kol Skywalker]]&mdash;who all correctly suspected a trap&mdash;[[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] Triumvir [[Nu Toreena]] and Petan convinced the third Triumvir, [[Bail Antilles (Galactic Alliance)|Bail Antilles]] to go ahead with the strike. As Stazi had not supported Petan's plans, the rear admiral sent Stazi and his fleet to the back of the strikeforce.<ref name="Legacy 20" />

In the resulting [[Battle of Caamas|battle]], the Galactic Alliance fell to the [[Fel Empire|Imperial]] trap and was soundly defeated. Petan accepted [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Morlish Veed]]'s terms of surrender, and ordered the entire fleet to do so as well. However, Admiral Stazi refused to surrender and escaped to continue the fight as the leader of a [[Galactic Alliance Remnant|resistance movement]].<ref name="Legacy 21">[[Legacy (2006) 21|''Legacy'' (2006) 21]]</ref>
